children: Sweden's centre-left opposition bloc looked set to win a majority in Sunday's vote for parliament, a TV4 election day poll showed.
The survey by the Novus polling agency gave the centre-left bloc 51.3% support against 47% for the ruling right-wing bloc.
Voting in the election ended at 1800 GMT, with ballots set to be counted in the hours ahead.
